Identical values between Zheng and Zhao (2022) and Roginski et al. (2024):

DeNovoGeneAnnotation:

	inputData:
		annotated genome

	inputAnnotGenome:

		annotGenomeChoice:
			homology-based approach

	phylogeneticTaxa:

		taxSpecificity:
			lineage-specific

	homologyFilter:

		seqType:
			protein sequences
